map.基于燃料模型、风速、坡度和湿度，估算野火蔓延速度、火线强度与过火面积: Estimate wildfire spread rate, fireline intensity and burned area from the fuel model, wind speed, slope and humidity.
map.火线蔓延速率按 Rothermel 简化模型：R = f(燃料载量, 热值, 表: Fireline spread rate by the simplified Rothermel model: R = f(fuel load, heat content, surface-to-volume ratio) multiplied by the wind factor φw and slope factor φs; predicted spread distance after t hours = R·t.
map.风速：最主要加速因素，风速每增加 1 倍，蔓延速度可增加 2~4 倍: Wind speed: the dominant accelerating factor; doubling wind speed can raise the spread rate 2-4×
map.坡度：上坡加速（每 10° 约 1 倍），下坡减速: Slope: accelerates uphill (about 1× per 10°), decelerates downhill
map.湿度：湿度越低，燃料含水率越低，越易燃烧: Humidity: the lower the humidity, the lower the fuel moisture content and the easier it burns
map.燃料：载量越大、颗粒越细，蔓延越快: Fuel: the greater the load and the finer the particles, the faster the spread
map.火线强度 I = 258 × R × W（R=蔓延速度 m/min，W=燃料载量: Fireline intensity I = 258 × R × W (R = spread rate in m/min, W = fuel load in t/ha)
map.火焰高度估算 H = 0.0775 × I^0.46（I 单位 kW/m）: Flame-height estimate H = 0.0775 × I^0.46 (I in kW/m)
map.火焰高度 > 3.5m 时，直接灭火已不可能，须转入隔离防御: When flame height > 3.5 m, direct suppression is no longer possible and the response must shift to isolation and defense
map.野火行为受复杂地形和微气象影响极大，本工具为简化估算，实际扑救须依据专业火行为预: Wildfire behavior is strongly affected by complex terrain and micro-meteorology; this tool is a simplified estimate, and actual suppression must rely on a professional fire-behavior prediction system.
map.📚 深度解析：林火蔓延预测: 📚 In-Depth Analysis: Forest Fire Spread Prediction
map.森林防火中按燃料、风速、坡度、湿度预测蔓延速度与火线强度。: In forest fire prevention, predict the spread rate and fireline intensity from fuel, wind speed, slope and humidity.
map.评估过火面积与灭火策略（直接灭火/设阻火带/待燃尽）。: Assess the burned area and suppression strategy (direct attack/firebreak/let-burn).
map.演练演示风因子、坡度因子对蔓延的放大效应。: In drills, demonstrate the amplifying effect of the wind factor and slope factor on spread.
map.灌木丛、风速 20 km/h、坡度 15° 的蔓延: Spread in shrubland with 20 km/h wind and 15° slope
map.按默认参数（灌木丛载量 7 t/ha、风速 20 km/h≈5.6 m/s、坡度: With the default parameters (shrubland load 7 t/ha, wind speed 20 km/h≈5.6 m/s, slope 15°, humidity 40%, prediction 3 h): wind factor ×4.93, slope factor ×1.42, humidity factor ×0.80; spread rate 1.11 m/min (66 m/h), fireline intensity 60 kW/m, flame height 0.5 m; spread distance about 199 m in 3 hours and burned area about 4.98 ha. The suppression strategy recommended is 'direct attack feasible (hand tools + water)'.
map.风对林火蔓延影响多大？: How much does wind affect forest fire spread?
map.风是主导因子，本例 20 km/h 对应风因子约 4.93，即蔓延速度被放大约: Wind is the dominant factor; here 20 km/h corresponds to a wind factor of about 4.93, i.e. the spread rate is amplified about 5×; in strong winds the fireline intensity and spotting risk surge, making it one of the most dangerous suppression conditions.
map.坡度为什么也放大蔓延？: Why does slope also amplify spread?
map.火向上坡蔓延时热烟气预热上方植被、火焰更贴坡面，坡度越大蔓延越快；15° 对应坡: When fire spreads uphill, hot smoke preheats the vegetation above and the flame hugs the slope more closely, so the steeper the slope the faster the spread; 15° corresponds to a slope factor of about 1.42, and for steep slopes (>30°) the factor can exceed 2.
map.基于简化火行为模型，结合燃料、风速、坡度、湿度和温度，估算野火蔓延速度、火线强度: Based on a simplified fire-behavior model and combining fuel, wind speed, slope, humidity and temperature, estimate the wildfire spread rate, fireline intensity, flame height and burned area.
